study_type: Descriptive single development-case diagnostic, not held-out comparison or preregistered study
selection: Existing first official training field and all three already published masks; no new outcome-based selection. Counts and masks were visible before this declaration.

matching.objective: Cardinality-first maximum-weight one-to-one matching using the frozen evaluator
matching.dense_label_remapping: Ascending nonzero IDs -> consecutive uint32 IDs, background0; preserve partition/geometry

inference_boundary: No new inference, parameters or weights. All predictions loaded and provenance checked before official annotation decoding. References may be used only to compute declared diagnostics.
failure_policy: Retain failures; no parameter tuning, reranking, additional cases or rewritten original benchmark. No overwriting differing output.
limitations: One already selected development field; descriptive only, no uncertainty interval or significance testing.
Model pretraining overlap with BBBC039 is unknown; no biological-group generalization or accuracy-superiority claim.
Official annotation agreement is not independent biological truth; reference quality and matching threshold affect results.
Merge/split counts are thresholded correspondence hypotheses, not clinically confirmed errors.
No human correction, recruitment, effort, benefit or scientific novelty is established.
Pairwise mask differences do not imply that either mask is wrong.
Protocol declared after original masks/counts were public; not a prospective independent study.
